crossRefs.note: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the…
“From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has…
but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…

translations.web: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
translations.bsb: So your life will hang in doubt before you, and you will be afraid night and day, never certain of survival.
translations.kjv: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
translations.asv: and thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear night and day, and shalt have no assurance of thy life.
